extDescription.message: Adds a download button to every post on X that sends it to your TwimShelf app or server.

extensionReloaded.message: The extension was updated. Reload this page.

errorOffline.message: $1 cannot be reached (is the app open?)

errorUnbound.message: The device no longer knows this browser: bind it again.

errorLost.message: The device no longer has this download

manualTitle.message: Reach a device by its address

noTasks.message: Downloads you send from X show here.

unbindConfirm.message: Unbind $1? This browser can no longer send downloads to it.

errorWrongCode.message: Wrong code. Check the code shown in the app.

errorExpired.message: The code has expired. Show a new one in the app.

errorNoCode.message: The app shows no code right now (or it was used up). Choose “Bind a Browser” in the app.

errorUnreachable.message: The device cannot be reached at that address.

errorTooOld.message: That device runs an older TwimShelf without the extension. Update it.

errorTooNew.message: That device needs a newer version of this extension.

errorBadText.message: That is neither a 6-digit code nor a binding text.

errorNothing.message: Type the code, or paste the binding text.

stepOpen.message: In TwimShelf, open **Settings → Browser Extension → Bind a Browser**.

stepEnter.message: Type the 6-digit code here. For another computer or a Linux server, paste the binding text instead.

manualHint.message: Only needed when the binding text's addresses don't work (another network, a VPN). The code above is used with this address.

errorNoCodeHere.message: No TwimShelf on this computer is showing a code. Choose “Bind a Browser” in the app first; for another computer, paste the binding text.

errorNoLocal.message: No TwimShelf is open on this computer. Open it, or paste the binding text of a device elsewhere.

howToUse.message: On X, every post now has a download button next to bookmark and share.
